findings.claim: §8 Threshold A CODEOWNERS criterion still references vendor/scp-public.key (the stale pre-fix path) after COR-MAJ-002 corrected §5 step 3 to docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub. The two sections are now inconsistent: §5 correctly names the WP-SCP-021-established key file path; §8's gate criterion at 023E would check CODEOWNERS coverage on a path that neither currently exists nor will exist in the working tree.
findings.evidence: docs/plans/WP-SCP-023-cross-repo-scorecards.md §8 Threshold A criterion (post-fix-round-1, line 223): 'CODEOWNERS coverage confirmed on docs/scorecards/** + output/scorecards/** + vendor/scp-public.key + .github/workflows/scorecard-aggregator.yml + schemas/scorecard-*.schema.json.' docs/plans/WP-SCP-023-cross-repo-scorecards.md §5 step 3 (post-fix-round-1): 'verifies each emit signature against the SCP-side key registry at docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub (the WP-SCP-021-established path; CODEOWNERS-covered via docs/security/**).' FIX-ROUND-1.md inline-fix summary item 3: 'docs/plans/WP-SCP-023-cross-repo-scorecards.md §5 step 3: vendor/scp-public.key → docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub' — §8 was not in the fix scope.
findings.impact: At 023E, an operator evaluating Threshold A against §8's CODEOWNERS criterion would check for coverage on vendor/scp-public.key — a path that does not exist and will not be created under the architecture committed in §5. The actual signing key at docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub IS already covered by the existing docs/security/** CODEOWNERS rule, so the functional protection is in place. However the stated gate criterion is wrong, creating two risks: (1) a false-PASS where the operator checks vendor/** in CODEOWNERS and concludes coverage exists without realising the criterion path is wrong; (2) a false-FAIL where a careful operator finds vendor/scp-public.key as a literal entry is absent and incorrectly concludes CODEOWNERS coverage is missing. Either outcome corrupts the 023E gate-integrity assessment. The inconsistency between §5 and §8 also misleads the 023C Codex executor, which reads both sections as its implementation reference.
findings.mitigation: Inline-fix (no descope): update §8 Threshold A CODEOWNERS criterion from 'vendor/scp-public.key' to 'docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub' to match the §5 correction. Recommended replacement text for the criterion line: 'CODEOWNERS coverage confirmed on docs/scorecards/** + output/scorecards/** + docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub (via docs/security/**) + .github/workflows/scorecard-aggregator.yml + schemas/scorecard-*.schema.json.' No new CODEOWNERS entry is required — docs/security/** already covers docs/security/mcp-signing-keys.pub per the existing CODEOWNERS rule.
